title: No Human Tongue Can Tell
label: Rough Trade Records
notes: Debut solo album by Lankum/ØXN vocalist. 9 trad-folk tracks (Hares on the Mountain, Willow Garden, Bonnie Boy...). Peat plays all the intersecting parts herself (Tubular Bells inspiration). Single rewrites lyrics with coded references to unwanted pregnancy/abortion. Folk, not rock; dark drone-folk fits goth/Americana fringe. Also covered by NME, Uncut, Clash, KLOF (Sept. 2026).

title: Gentling the Horse at the Walt Whitman Mall
label: SUCK
notes: Not on New West: debut release of Rose's own imprint SUCK (formerly New West artist). Produced by John Congleton. Earlier singles 'Chow Mein' (Aug. 11 announcement, Stereogum/Consequence) and 'Yip Yip Now'. 'Hello Again, Jim' is a fuzz-riff send-up of toxic music-industry dudes. Date of the Hello Again, Jim / Calm pair not confirmed.
